mapper.select: SELECT his_idx AS hisIdx, store_idx AS storeIdx, chg_type AS chgType, store_nm AS storeNm, chg_content::text AS chgContentRaw, chg_user_id AS chgUserId, CAST(chg_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS chgDt FROM store_history WHERE store_idx = #{storeIdx} ORDER BY chg_dt DESC, his_idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_history (store_idx, chg_type, chg_user_id, store_nm, chg_content) VALUES (#{storeIdx}, #{chgType}, #{chgUserId}, #{storeNm}, jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object( 'column_nm', 'store', 'column_desc', '가맹점', 'before_value', null, 'after_value', #{summaryContent} )))
INSERT INTO store_history (store_idx, chg_type, chg_user_id, store_nm, chg_content, chg_dt) VALUES (#{storeIdx}, #{chgType}, #{chgUserId}, #{storeNm}, to_jsonb(#{summaryText}::text), #{chgDt})
INSERT INTO store_history (store_idx, chg_type, chg_user_id, store_nm, chg_content) VALUES (#{storeIdx}, 'UPDATE', #{chgUserId}, #{storeNm}, CAST(#{jsonBody} AS JSONB))
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND t.relname = 'store_history' AND c.conname = 'fk_his_store_idx' )
